_doc: Per-arena light emitters whose floor falloff is a PROTECTED feature (look-bible §grade-doctrine b). critique.py, grade_preview.py and verdict_risk.py read this table with --arena <name> so --emitter is never guessed. Positions are FRACTIONS of the captured frame (x right, y down) per harness viewport (desk 1280x720 high tier, phone 393x851 @2.75 low tier) and name the point on the FLOOR where the emitter meets it (the base of a lava fall, the centre of a window's light pool), not the emitter geometry itself. radii_css_px are the falloff rings critique.py measures per view (ring 0 = the emitter itself, near = second, far = last); the phone rings are smaller because its viewport is 393 CSS px wide and the pool spans fewer CSS px (a 250 px disc would cover 45 % of the portrait frame). status: verified = read off a gridded zoom of the named capture; proposed = located by eye on a capture, re-check before trusting the numbers; none = the arena has no floor emitter (falloff is not a protected feature there).

volcanic.emitter: lava fall base (the sheet meets the floor pool); the floor pool and the glowing cracks fan out from here
volcanic.source: pilot/orbkin-art-direction-1/base/raw/volcanic-{desk,phone}.clean.png (HEAD 3e82e65, frame 208), gridded 3x zoom 2026-10-15; desk fall base x 590-600 px, y 340-355 px; phone x 280-300, y 750-790 device px
volcanic.baseline_numbers_hint: accepted frame HEAD 3e82e65 (critique.py --arena volcanic): desk near_bstar 39.8, gradient_L 22.3, far_bstar 27.4; phone near_bstar 26.3, gradient_L 11.5; full rows in game/docs/research/retunes/volcanic.md

cave.emitter: window light pool on the floor (the two shafts from the back-wall windows land here)
cave.source: jc/current/raw/cave-desk.clean.png (HEAD fa40185), by eye; the phone pool was not located (the portrait frame crops the shafts): run critique.py --emitter by hand after reading the phone capture

hollow.note: canopy-gap dapple, no single floor emitter; falloff is not a protected feature here

meadow.note: sun key + gobo pool; the focal pool under the kin is a dressing/gobo feature, measure it with --focal, not --emitter

scrub.note: sunset key from the frame edge

summit.note: night set with brazier flames: locate on a capture (gridded zoom) before a retune and move it to verified

stadium.note: night floodlights from above; no floor emitter
